items.title: Kering stock: Goldman Sachs cuts Gucci forecast for Q4
items.summary: Goldman Sachs cut Kering's price target from 230 to 215 euros and revised its Gucci Q4 organic sales forecast to a 4.3% decline, with retail sales seen falling 4% and wholesale 5%; the bank still flags room for recovery in 2027 but keeps a neutral rating.

items.title: Kering-Aktie: Goldman Sachs senkt Kursziel auf 215 Euro
items.summary: German-language wire follow-up on the Goldman Sachs downgrade, reiterating the lowered Kering price target and framing Gucci's stalled recovery as the dominant swing factor pressuring Kering shares into the week.

items.title: Gucci Brings Latest Retail Concept to the U.K. Via Harrods
items.summary: Gucci's relocated 1,170-sq-ft womenswear boutique at Harrods debuts the Demna-era store concept for the first time in the UK, the second global rollout after the Paris Avenue Montaigne flagship, drawing on Italian Renaissance palazzo spatial logic.

items.title: Gucci Beauty debuts a brand new boutique in Harrods, London (new concept)
items.summary: Trade coverage of the new Gucci Beauty boutique at Harrods, built around 'The Alchemist's Garden' fragrance concept and a reworked makeup counter design, pitched as merging heritage Florentine materials with a more playful retail experience.

items.title: Gucci price cutting could be a sensible strategy, amid global turmoil
items.summary: Analysis citing Luca Solca arguing Gucci's summer price cuts (e.g. the Padlock bag from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450) are a defensible response to weak upper-middle-class demand in China, while warning the move risks diminishing exclusivity and alienating full-price buyers; notes Louis Vuitton has not followed despite an 8% Q3 sales drop per Goldman.

items.title: Gucci reportedly cuts prices as turnaround pressure builds
items.summary: UK trade coverage detailing unannounced Gucci price adjustments across sneakers, handbags and RTW in Europe after thirteen consecutive quarters of sales declines, with cuts quietly applied online over summer rather than formally announced.

items.title: After price cuts at Gucci, Kering appoints a group director of pricing
items.summary: Reports that Kering has created a new group-level pricing-director role in the wake of the Gucci price-cut controversy, read by trade press as an admission that pricing discipline across the group needs centralized oversight after Gucci's unannounced reductions.

items.title: Gucci's Price Cuts Expose a Bigger Problem for Luxury Fashion
items.summary: Commentary arguing Gucci's 30% handbag price cuts signal a structural crisis across luxury fashion beyond one brand, warning that past full-price buyers may feel burned and prospective buyers may now wait for further markdowns, eroding pricing power industry-wide.

items.title: Gucci watchmaking division cuts 30 jobs in Switzerland
items.summary: Gucci Swiss Timepieces will eliminate about 30 of 95 roles at its Cortaillod (Neuchatel) factory as logistics functions move to Gucci's Trecate, Italy site; consultation runs to December 4, the second collective redundancy at the unit in two years.

items.title: Gucci supprime une trentaine de postes dans son usine horlogère de Cortaillod
items.summary: Union Unia confirmed roughly 30 jobs at risk at Gucci's Cortaillod watch plant; union secretary Solenn Ochsner called the difficulties structural rather than cyclical, with cuts not expected before 2027 at the earliest.

items.title: Vague de licenciements chez Gucci Swiss Timepieces à Cortaillod
items.summary: Swiss outlet watson.ch covers the Cortaillod layoff wave alongside concurrent cuts at watchmaker Zenith, framing both as part of a broader rough patch for the Neuchatel watch valley tied to weak luxury demand.

items.title: 25 emplois menacés chez Gucci
items.summary: Regional Swiss TV segment on threatened jobs at the Gucci Cortaillod watch plant, covering local worker and union reaction to the announced restructuring.

items.title: Zenith, Gucci: pourquoi les grandes maisons horlogères suppriment-elles autant d'emplois?
items.summary: Horology trade blog analyzes why both Zenith and Gucci's Swiss watch units are cutting jobs simultaneously, pointing to softening luxury watch demand and overcapacity built up during the post-pandemic boom.

items.title: Gucci Sets Up New Business Units' Organization
items.summary: Gucci restructures into business units with industry veterans Monica Ulmi and Marco Semeghini joining as senior advisers based between Milan and Florence, working alongside Demna and CEO Francesca Bellettini.

items.title: Mariah Carey Checks In for Christmas in Gucci's 2026 Holiday Campaign
items.summary: WWD covers Gucci's 2026 holiday campaign starring Mariah Carey, directed by Harmony Korine, built around her 1994 hit and promoting bags including the Starlet and GG Marmont plus Horsebit loafers; included as the still-circulating baseline activation story this fortnight.

items.title: Gucci Black Friday 2026
items.summary: Consumer guide confirming Gucci will not run a Black Friday or Cyber Monday sale on gucci.com or in boutiques in 2026, noting third-party retailer, beauty and pre-owned promotions are the only route to discounts from roughly Nov 20 to Nov 30.

items.title: Reuters X post: Gucci sales slip again in latest blow to Kering recovery plan
items.summary: Official Reuters X account post linking to the Q3 sales-decline story; retained as the most-shared wire-agency social post still being referenced in ongoing Kering/Gucci stock commentary threads this week.

items.title: Demna Gvasalia - Designer, Creative Director of Gucci - forum thread
items.summary: Active EU-priority community thread tracking Demna's Gucci tenure; recent pages carry pointed quality complaints, e.g. members calling recent bumbags and the east-west horsebit top-handle bag impractical and citing 'more than 10 failed new product releases... a disaster', alongside some defenders of the direction.

items.title: Forum Members Review Demna's Fall 2026 Runway Debut as Gucci Creative Director
items.summary: Syndicated roundup of TheFashionSpot forum reactions to Demna's Gucci debut, including critical comments like 'everything Demna does is one big cliche' and 'a new low for Gucci,' mixed with comparisons to Tom Ford-era references and some praise for styling choices.

items.title: Gucci's watch division will cut 30 jobs in Switzerland / relocated Harrods boutique takes new concept to UK
items.summary: Trade-wire summary bundling the Harrods new-concept boutique opening with the parallel Swiss watch division job-cut news, illustrating Gucci's split narrative of retail investment alongside cost-cutting in the same week.

items.title: Gucci lowers prices: Luca de Meo's strategy
items.summary: Italian trade outlet nss magazine examines whether Gucci's price cuts reflect a deliberate repositioning under Kering CEO Luca de Meo, questioning whether discounting resolves or deepens the brand's desirability problem.

items.title: Gucci baisse le prix de certains sacs face au recul des ventes
items.summary: French-language report confirming the Padlock bag price drop in France from EUR3,500 to EUR2,450 (~30%), with Kering describing it as a targeted correction limited to certain discontinued seasonal items rather than a broad repricing.
